question_vi: Implement deep clone object (không dùng structuredClone)?
question_en: Implement a deep clone function (without using structuredClone).
answer_html_vi:
Deep clone sao chép đệ quy toàn bộ nested values mà không giữ reference gốc.

js
function deepClone(obj) {
  if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') return obj;
  const clone = Array.isArray(obj) ? [] : {};
  for (const key in obj) {
    if (obj.hasOwnProperty(key)) clone[key] = deepClone(obj[key]);
  }
  return clone;
}

Lưu ý: không handle Date, RegExp, Map, Set, circular refs.

Production dùng structuredClone() hoặc lodash.
answer_html_en:
A deep clone copies every nested value recursively, keeping no reference to the original.

js
function deepClone(obj) {
  if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') return obj;
  const clone = Array.isArray(obj) ? [] : {};
  for (const key in obj) {
    if (obj.hasOwnProperty(key)) clone[key] = deepClone(obj[key]);
  }
  return clone;
}

Note: this does not handle Date, RegExp, Map, Set or circular references.

In production use structuredClone() or lodash.
